_om: Hviskeren in English (Whisperer, rusj.no/en/whisperer/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A co-operative clue game: one guesser, everybody else writes one clue in secret, and clues that are the same cancel out («strøket» = struck out). A «lapp» is a slip of paper. The words come from the English word bank (data/kategorier.en); clues are compared with English word forms (dog/dogs, baby/babies, run/running). Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
The clue needs letters or numbers.
Det er jo selve ordet! Finn på noe annet: That's the word itself! Think of something else.
For likt ordet – det er en del av det. P: Too close to the word – it's part of it. Try another clue.
Alle sammen. Hvert eneste ord. Dere dele: Every single one. Every last word. You must share one brain.
Nesten feilfritt – dere er på samme bølg: Almost perfect – you're on the same wavelength.
Brilliant! Most of the clues hit the mark.
More right than wrong. That's a good sign.
Noen hint fløy forbi, men dere er på vei: A few clues flew past, but you're getting there.
Hintene kom fram, men ikke helt slik der: The clues got through, just not quite the way you meant.
Det var mer hvisking enn treff denne gan: More whispering than hitting this time. Another round?
Et samarbeidsspill. Én gjetter, de andre: A team game. One guesser, the others give one clue each – but matching clues are struck out!
De andre ser det hemmelige ordet sammen: The others look at the secret word together on the phone.
Ett hint hver, på en lapp eller på egen: One clue each, on a slip of paper or on your own phone. The phone keeps time: {tid} s.
Legg bort hint som er like, og vis reste: Put aside clues that match and show the rest to the guesser. A right answer scores one point.
Send mobilen rundt. Alle skriver ett ord: Pass the phone round. Everyone writes one word in secret.
Like hint strykes, og gjetteren ser bare: Matching clues are struck out and the guesser only sees the rest. A right answer scores one point.
Pass er gratis, men feil svar koster et: Passing is free, but a wrong answer costs an extra card from the pile.
Det mest opplagte hintet blir ofte strøk: The most obvious clue is often struck out – think a little differently from the others.
Bøyninger regnes som like: bil, bilen og: Different forms count as the same: dog, dogs and dog's strike each other out.
Er dere bare tre, gir hver av dere to hi: If there are only three of you, you each give two clues.
Har dere ikke lapper? Velg «Én mobil», s: No paper? Choose ‘One phone’ and pass the phone round instead.
Er dere mange? Velg «Alle samtidig», så: A big group? Choose ‘Everyone at once’ and everyone writes on paper or their own phone.
Vanskelig: det mest opplagte hintet står: Hard: the most obvious clue is printed on the card – and it's banned.
Men like hint blir strøket!: But matching clues are struck out!
Mobilen viser ordet og tar tiden. Alle s: The phone shows the word and keeps time. Everyone writes their clue at once, and you compare them yourselves.
Mobilen går fra hånd til hånd. Like hint: The phone goes from hand to hand. Matching clues are struck out automatically.
Dere er tre, så hver av dere gir to hint: There are three of you, so you each give two clues.
Da blir det mye venting med én mobil – d: That's a lot of waiting with one phone – it's quicker when everyone writes at once.
Det mest opplagte hintet står på kortet: The most obvious clue is on the card – and it's not allowed.
Snu deg bort – ikke se på mobilen!: Turn away – don't look at the phone!
Vis hintene til de andre: Show the clues to the others
Vis ordet til de andre: Show the word to the others
Hemmelig ord – bare for dere som gir hin: Secret word – only for the clue givers
Se på ordet sammen. Når klokka starter,: Look at the word together. When the clock starts, you each write two clues – on a slip of paper or on your own phone.
Look at the word together. When the clock starts, everyone writes one clue – on a slip of paper or on your own phone.
Se på ordet sammen. Så går mobilen rundt: Look at the word together. Then the phone goes round and you each write two clues in secret.
Look at the word together. Then the phone goes round and everyone writes one clue in secret.
Two clues, one word in each.
Like hint blir strøket, så tenk litt ann: Matching clues are struck out, so think a little differently from the others!
Matching clues have been struck out automatically.
Ingen hint var helt like!: No clues were exactly the same!
Trykk på et hint for å stryke det – elle: Tap a clue to strike it out – or bring it back.
Gi mobilen til gjetteren: Pass the phone to the guesser
Gi mobilen til gjetteren,: Pass the phone to the guesser,
Alle hintene ble strøket. Gjett i blinde: Every clue was struck out. Guess blind – or pass.
Say your guess out loud – then check the answer.
På lapper eller på egen mobil. Ett ord i: On paper or on your own phone. One word in each clue – and keep them hidden until both are done.
På en lapp eller på din egen mobil. Bare: On a slip of paper or on your own phone. Just one word – and keep it hidden until everyone is done.
Bil og bilen er like, og «{hint}» er for: Dog and dogs count as one; ‘{hint}’ is banned. Unsure? Remove both.
Bil og bilen er like. I tvil? Legg bort: Dog and dogs count as one. Unsure? Remove both.
But not the phone! Just one try.
Well done! One point to the team.
Au! Feil svar koster et ekstra kort fra: Ouch! A wrong answer costs an extra card from the pile.
Au! Det var siste kort, så det koster ik: Ouch! That was the last card, so it costs nothing more.
No harm done – passing is free.
You didn't get to any cards this time.
Godt jobba så langt! Rekorden teller bar: Well done so far! The record only counts when the whole pile is played.
Dere stoppet før bunken var tom. Prøv ig: You stopped before the pile was empty. Try again whenever you like!
Første runde – nå har dere en rekord å s: First game – now you have a record to beat!
Første runde med dette oppsettet – nå ha: First game with these settings – now you have a record to beat!
«{hint}» er forbudt denne runden. Finn p: ‘{hint}’ is banned this round. Think of something cleverer!
Ordene trekkes fra kategoriene dere velg: The words are drawn from the categories you choose.
Pass. No point, and no card lost.
Right! One point to the team.
Wrong answer. That costs an extra card.
Dere går til kåringen med poengene så la: You'll go to the results with the points so far.
